title: Pairs That Fit
statement: Given an array of box weights and a target, return how many pairs of different boxes (i < j) weigh exactly the target together.

answerKey.pattern: One pass with a hash map counting the weights seen so far
keyPoints: For each weight w, the pairs it completes are the earlier weights equal to target - w
Add the count of target - w from the map
Then add w to the map
edgeCases: Equal weights such as [3, 3, 3] with target 6 (3 pairs)
A box cannot pair with itself

hints: For each box, which weight would complete it?
Count the weights you have already passed in a map.
Add from the map before adding the current box, so it never pairs with itself.
